question: For each person role and IAP category, list the role, the category name, the number of people in this role, and the average fee, sorted by the role count in descending order.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "iap_subject_detail" AS SELECT "iap_subject_person_key" AS "iap_subject_person_key", "iap_subject_category_key" AS "iap_subject_category_key", "fee" AS "fee" FROM beaver."iap_subject_detail";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "iap_subject_person" AS SELECT "iap_subject_person_key" AS "iap_subject_person_key", "person_role" AS "person_role" FROM beaver."iap_subject_person";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "iap_subject_category" AS SELECT "iap_subject_category_key" AS "iap_subject_category_key", "iap_category_name" AS "iap_category_name" FROM beaver."iap_subject_category";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT
  p.person_role AS role,
  c.iap_category_name AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count,
  AVG(d.fee) AS average_fee
FROM iap_subject_detail d
JOIN iap_subject_person p
  ON d.iap_subject_person_key = p.iap_subject_person_key
JOIN iap_subject_category c
  ON d.iap_subject_category_key = c.iap_subject_category_key
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY people_count DESC, role, category_name
LIMIT 200

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    p.person_role AS role,
    c.iap_category_name AS category_name,
    d.iap_subject_person_key,
    d.fee
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_person p
    ON d.iap_subject_person_key = p.iap_subject_person_key
  JOIN iap_subject_category c
    ON d.iap_subject_category_key = c.iap_subject_category_key
)
SELECT 
  role,
  category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fee IS NOT NULL AND fee >= 0 THEN fee END) AS average_fee
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1,2
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT iap_subject_person_key) > 0
ORDER BY people_count DESC, role, category_name
LIMIT 200;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH by_role AS (
  SELECT 
    p.person_role AS role,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN d.fee IS NOT NULL AND d.fee >= 0 THEN d.fee END) AS average_fee
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_person p ON d.iap_subject_person_key = p.iap_subject_person_key
  GROUP BY 1
),
by_category_proxy AS (
  SELECT 
    d.iap_subject_category_key AS category_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY people_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
  r.role,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS category_name,
  r.people_count,
  r.average_fee
FROM by_role r
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '— top category (unmatched to name)' AS role,
  category_key AS category_name,
  people_count,
  NULL AS average_fee
FROM by_category_proxy
ORDER BY people_count DESC NULLS LAST, role
LIMIT 200;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    p.person_role AS role,
    c.iap_category_name AS category_name,
    d.iap_subject_person_key,
    d.fee
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_person p
    ON d.iap_subject_person_key = p.iap_subject_person_key
  LEFT JOIN iap_subject_category c
    ON upper(d.iap_subject_category_key) = upper(c.iap_subject_category_key)
)
SELECT 
  role,
  COALESCE(category_name, '[Unmapped category]') AS category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count,
  AVG(CASE WHEN fee IS NOT NULL AND fee >= 0 THEN fee END) AS average_fee
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY people_count DESC, role, category_name
LIMIT 200;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH by_role AS (
  SELECT 
    p.person_role AS role,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN d.fee IS NOT NULL AND d.fee >= 0 THEN d.fee END) AS average_fee
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_person p ON d.iap_subject_person_key = p.iap_subject_person_key
  GROUP BY 1
), top_cats AS (
  SELECT 
    d.iap_subject_category_key AS category_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY people_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
  role,
  '[Unmapped category]' AS category_name,
  people_count,
  average_fee
FROM by_role
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '— top category key (proxy)' AS role,
  category_key AS category_name,
  people_count,
  NULL AS average_fee
FROM top_cats
ORDER BY people_count DESC NULLS LAST, role
LIMIT 200;

# Final: provide role-level counts/avg fee and append a proxy section with top 5 raw category keys (unmapped)
query = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH by_role AS (
  SELECT 
    p.person_role AS role,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN d.fee IS NOT NULL AND d.fee >= 0 THEN d.fee END) AS average_fee
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  JOIN iap_subject_person p ON d.iap_subject_person_key = p.iap_subject_person_key
  GROUP BY 1
), top_cats AS (
  SELECT 
    d.iap_subject_category_key AS category_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.iap_subject_person_key) AS people_count
  FROM iap_subject_detail d
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY people_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
  role,
  '[Unmapped category]' AS category_name,
  people_count,
  average_fee
FROM by_role
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '— top category key (proxy)' AS role,
  category_key AS category_name,
  people_count,
  NULL AS average_fee
FROM top_cats
ORDER BY people_count DESC NULLS LAST, role
LIMIT 200;
'''

db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, query)
